rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that moves quickly or is capable of moving quickly.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 ce1 haang4 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something quickly, often appearing as 快啲 in casual requests.
Use this when stressing that something should be completed as soon as possible.

example.english: I'll get back to you as fast as possible.
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 zeon6 faai3 fuk1 nei5

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when urging someone to get on with something briskly.

example.jyutping: faai3 faai3 sau2 zou6 jyun4 fan6 gung1 fo3 laa1
